description: v2.1.0 section 7, Shared Element Modules — a reusable module combining several predicates into one named requirement (e.g. negligence_bundle, omission_bundle), so complex recurring doctrine does not get re-derived per offense.

requires.description: Section 7's examples (negligence_bundle, omission_bundle) show a flat conjunctive list — that is the implicit-ALL degenerate case of this same element_expression grammar (see common.schema.json), not a separate simpler grammar.
